topContent.text: ARDaC: Alcohol-associated Hepatitis Research Data Commons

bottomContent.text:
The AlcHepNet Research Data Commons, or ARDaC, is an integrative environment for exploring the clinical and omics data generated by AlcHepNet and related translational studies, and for investigators within the network to access data. ARDaC is sponsored by the National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism.

If you have any questions, contact the [ARDaC Development Team](mailto:ardac@iu.edu).
